integrationHistory: Seven-lane fan-out: T112 Bicep quant runtime, T049 soak tooling + bounded live launch, T126 shadow/go-live, T128 sweep runner, T168 model registry, T169 protected-test authority client, T211 chat-owned steering + SSE.

T112 live costs: quant identity, harness-results/harness-state containers, killswitch table, quant API (scale-to-zero), RTH trader (KEDA cron), optional crypto trader, backtest Container Apps Job; secrets must be seeded before first start (alpaca-paper/live keys, harness-api-bearer-token).

T049 launched a live bounded soak against the dev API (temporary external-ingress posture applied and fully restored); the full 2016-to-today run is one command and resumable; lake row-cap gap (1000 records/data-type ingest bound) recorded for T050 cost math.

T211 fixed a latent bug: the thesis chat router's Depends() silently degraded to a query parameter under postponed annotations, making the router unusable; fixed via module-level get_chat_service reading app.state (lake composition pattern).
limitations: Trader containers fail-loop until the trader runtime composition lands (harness trader is scaffolded-only); per-run backtest config must be supplied via job-start container-arg override (sweep runner contract documented).
Shadow intents cover order submissions only (cancel/replace unobservable through PaperShell without a venue-factory seam); kill-switch remains in-process pending the T112 table client.
Registry-to-foundry deployment enforcement and the cutoff-overlap evidence modifier are follow-up seams; T169's registry wiring into submissions is a small integration task.
Chat-message SSE frames are ephemeral (no durable per-message cursor) pending a chat contracts schema change.
